Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Bharti Rally 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Air Force (IAF) has announced a recruitment rally for male candidates, including Indian and Gorkha, to join as Airmen in Group ‘Y’ (Non-Technical) for the Medical Assistant Trade. Rally for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 has started from 29 January 2025 & the rally end date 06 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Rally Start Date : 29 January 2025
  • Rally Last Date : 06 February 2025

Application Fee

  • No Fees For All Candidates

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Bharti Rally 2025?

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Bharti Rally 2025 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 06 February 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://airmenselection.cdac.in/CASB/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
